title: Restricted-vector norm bound
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, and let $A$ be a real $n\times n$ symmetric matrix with nonnegative entries and row sums equal to $1$. Define $\lambda(A)$ as the supremum of $\|Av\|$ over unit vectors orthogonal to the constant vector with entries $1/n$. Suppose $\lambda(A)\le\lambda$, $0\le\lambda\le1$, and $\beta\ge0$. For a subset $B\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ with $|B|\le\beta n$, define $r_0$ to have entry $1/n$ on $B$ and $0$ elsewhere, and recursively set $r_{k+1}=A_Br_k$, where $A_B$ is obtained from $A$ by replacing rows outside $B$ by zero. Then for every integer $k\ge0$, $\|r_k\|\le\big((1-\lambda)\sqrt{\beta}+\lambda\big)^k\|r_0\|$.
